result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly coherent, but several elements are clipped or truncated at the viewport edges and the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its title/metadata block. The bottom navigation bar also appears visually broken, with an oversized dark bar overlapping the search/bookmark icons and no labels.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar renders a thick dark horizontal bar that overlaps and obscures the middle icons (search/bookmark), and the icons are cut off at the bottom of the screen. Tab labels are missing entirely.
issues.suggestion: Remove or restyle the stray dark bar element, ensure the tab bar has adequate height with safe-area padding, and add text labels/aria-labels for each tab.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza image with a −20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Render the full card metadata (name, rating, ETA, delivery fee, cuisine) for every list item, or add skeleton/fallback text when data is missing.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its image is clipped by the viewport edge, with no visible affordance that the row scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek so partially visible cards look intentional, truncate names with an ellipsis, and add a scroll indicator or arrow control.

issues.description: The category chip row is also clipped at the right edge, with a partially visible chip after 'Healthy' that is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent gutter and snap scrolling to the chip carousel so cut-off chips are either fully hidden or clearly peeking.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circle with dark outline heart while the pizza card uses a dark circle with white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon treatment across all cards, using a consistent scrim for legibility over imagery.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' and the search placeholder use light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are clipped awkwardly at the card's right edge and the banner's bottom corners appear square while other cards are rounded.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes to the card radius and apply a uniform border radius to the banner.
